engine-overview.description: Understand the engine's structure, main folders, project workflow, and the systems documented in tlDR Engine.

getting-started.description: Set up your repository, connect the upstream remote, run the base engine, and prepare your project for custom work.

project-structure-and-standards.description: Organize custom content, understand @Engine and zzz Examples, and follow the recommended asset naming scheme.

party-system.description: Create and initialize party members, access their data, and manage the active party using the documented helpers.

cutscenes.description: Build queued cutscenes with dialogue, actor movement, waits, animations, audio, camera actions, and custom functions.

battles.description: Define enemies, ACTs, dialogue, turn objects, and the documented workflow for building battle patterns.

updating.description: Pull engine updates through Git, resolve merge conflicts, and keep project-specific changes easier to maintain.

inline-text-effects.description: Use inline commands for line breaks, pauses, colors, indentation resets, and custom text formatting.

api-reference.description: See a consolidated reference of the party, cutscene, battle, text, and setup APIs explicitly documented by the source.

categoryDescriptions.Party system: Party member constructors, initialization, active-party names, data access, and membership changes.
categoryDescriptions.Cutscenes: Queued actions, dialogue, movement, waits, animations, audio, camera control, and custom cutscene functions.
categoryDescriptions.Battles: Enemy objects, constructors, ACTs, mercy, dialogue, turn objects, and bullet-pattern workflow.
categoryDescriptions.Enemy constructors: Documented enemy fields such as stats, ACTs, dialogue, sprites, mercy, recruits, and turn objects.
categoryDescriptions.Battle turns: Turn objects, attack timing, and the example-based workflow for defensive bullet patterns.
categoryDescriptions.Inline text: Line breaks, pauses, colors, indentation resets, and inline command syntax.
categoryDescriptions.Project structure: Engine-owned folders, example content, custom scripts, asset prefixes, and naming conventions.
categoryDescriptions.Git and updates: Repository setup, upstream remotes, pulls, merge conflicts, and update workflow.
categoryDescriptions.Engine setup: Initial repository creation, base-engine testing, example exploration, and first project changes.
categoryDescriptions.Utilities: Helper functions and supporting APIs referenced by the documented systems.
